HTML → Figma capture bookmarklet

Drag this button to your browser's bookmarks bar:

HTML → Figma

Then, on any page you want to capture:

  1. Click the bookmarklet.
  2. Wait for the toast saying JSON is copied to clipboard.
  3. In Figma, open the HTML Importer (Local) plugin, paste the JSON, click Import.

If the drag-to-bookmarks flow doesn't work, copy the contents of capture/dist/bookmarklet.txt and paste it as the URL of a manually created bookmark.
